config.description: A diagnostic, not a result: one seed (0), FedAvg only, added after the privacy runs (3b) to test one hypothesis about known issue 4. With DP on, the platform clips the trainable weights of each update (about 11-fold on this data) but sends batch-norm running statistics unclipped, so the averaged model may pair barely-moved weights with fully-moved statistics. Three variants at clip norm 1.0 and no noise, otherwise identical to 3b (Kaggle subsample, Dirichlet alpha = 1.0, 20 rounds, same partition and the same training order as 3b's seed 0, via round_id_name): (a) clip only, BN statistics sent as the platform's DP sends them; (b) clip only, each hospital sends the global model's BN statistics back unchanged; (c) no clipping, no noise, a reference that should reproduce 3b's sigma = 0, seed 0 run. Clipping without noise exists only in the experiment harness; the platform still requires noise to enable DP.
config.title: Diagnostic for known issue 4: clipping and batch-norm statistics, ECG, MIT-BIH (one seed)
config.name: mitbih_ecg_dp_diagnostic
